card.name: Linking words just before meals or food
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, to, without, after, each) right before an expected word for meals, food or eating, mostly in dosing instructions like 'without regard to meals'.

modes.label: Without regard to meals
modes.description: 'of' or 'to' in phrases saying a drug can be taken regardless of food or meal timing.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION • May be taken without regard<< to>> food. ( 2.2 )

modes.label: Before or after meals
modes.description: A word like 'after' or 'each' that leads into 'meal' or 'meals' in timing instructions.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The average adult dose is 4 grams daily given as 1 gram after<< each>> meal and at bedtime. Children 6

modes.label: Non-drug eating context
modes.description: 'without' before 'stopping for food or water' in general text about birds.
modes.example: They can fly for up to eight hours straight<< without>> stopping for food or water.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict words like meals, meal, eating and eat next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before 'meals' or 'food' in phrases like 'without regard to meals'.
